name: AnimNode
doc: A typed animation graph node. The compiler validates fields for each kind.

fields.name: clip
fields.doc: Clip reference in canonical @path#id form, resolved by ara-asset.

fields.name: parameterX
fields.doc: Float parameter for a scalar axis, horizontal axis or optional layer weight.

fields.name: parameterY
fields.doc: Float parameter for a directional vertical axis.

fields.name: samples
fields.doc: Samples; additive/layer nodes use exactly two in base, overlay order.

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: Constant additive/layer weight when parameterX is empty.

fields.name: boneMask
fields.doc: Per-joint [0,1] weights for layer/additive nodes; empty means every joint.

fields.name: matching
fields.doc: Search/query/inertialization settings for a motion-matching node.
